title: WalletState
description: Normalized observation state representing on-chain and market telemetry observed by the agent

chainId.description: EVM Chain ID (84532 for Base Sepolia Testnet)

walletAddress.description: Connected EVM wallet or contract address

nativeBalanceWei.description: Exact native token balance in Wei as a string

nativeBalanceEth.description: Native token balance formatted in Ether

dailySpentEth.description: Cumulative amount spent by agent today in Ether

dailyLimitEth.description: Daily allowance ceiling enforced by smart contract

perTxLimitEth.description: Per-transaction limit enforced by smart contract

baseFeeGwei.description: Current network base gas fee in Gwei

slippageSpreadBps.description: Current observed liquidity spread or slippage delta in basis points

isContractPaused.description: Whether the target wallet contract is currently in emergency paused state

timestamp.description: UNIX timestamp in seconds when the state snapshot was recorded
